title: Session and agent-run history
statement: The system shall append one metadata-only entry per chat session and agent run to an append-only history, keep entries for 365 days and then compact them into one summary per month.
rationale: A durable, private record of when and how work happened shows gaps and patterns without storing conversation content.

acceptance_criteria.text: Each entry has kind, id, project, user, start, end, outcome, changesets proposed and applied, and records touched; 0 prompt, message or tool-output text is stored
Entries are only appended; compaction is the only rewrite, runs at most once per day and makes 1 commit
Entries older than 365 days are replaced by monthly summaries with session count, total duration and outcome counts, and 0 entries younger than 365 days are removed

A gap of 14 days or more between sessions is recorded as deliberate when a user paused the project with a reason, otherwise as unexplained, and the next session start shows the gap and lets the user give a reason

source: product owner request 2026-10-04; adapted from canoe
